name: engen-tech
description: Engen-Tech plugins: steward delegation, prose gate and orchestration, and plainlanguage.

plugins.name: steward-delegation
plugins.description: Delegation edict for Claude Code: seven pinned subagent profiles chosen by task complexity, and a gate that denies a second direct edit on the main thread.

plugins.name: steward-orchestration
plugins.description: Primary and secondary session roles for multi-session initiatives on Claude Code, with a shared registry of who directs whom.

plugins.name: steward-prose-gate
plugins.description: Blocks a reply or a gh pr create/edit body that reads like AI-generated text, and asks for a plain-language revision.
